attributes.name: Scrying Mirror
attributes.powers:
Discard this card to examine the top card of the location deck at an occupied location, or the top 2 cards if you have a role card. If you are not at that location, you may then shuffle that deck.

After playing this card, you may attempt an Arcane or Divine 13 check to recharge this card instead of discarding it.
